observations.behavior: Adds a new test class and four test methods, including a parameterized test, to verify HogQL access control behavior against REST expectations.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for HogQL access control, including checks that object grants narrow results rather than deny tables, and that creator exemptions are preserved. This supports the implementation of role-based access control and cache partitioning.

observations.behavior: Adds a cache payload entry for restricted resources and an allowlisted objects entry, and a restricted-for-user entry, while retaining existing restricted objects and restricted resources entries.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds cache fingerprint entries for allowlisted and restricted resources, and a restricted-for-user entry, to support cache partitioning when access control narrows queries. This could prevent cache collisions between users with identical resource restrictions but different object grants or creator exemptions.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method to retrieve allowlisted object IDs, scoped to queried resources, and returns a dictionary of resource to sorted IDs or None.
